# Whiteboard

> A minimalist browser whiteboard for mouse and pen tablets: one full-window canvas per board, multiple boards, five colours, a pen-size slider, and undo. Nothing is saved; a reload starts fresh.

The site is a single page with no accounts, no server and no storage. There is no panning or zooming and no eraser. Left click or the pen tip draws, right click or Ctrl+Z undoes, and the scroll wheel switches canvases. Pen pressure sets stroke width. The help panel lists the shortcuts and lets the user bind any key, mouse button or pen button to any action for the current session.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/delta1513/whiteboard.deltadelta.dev/main/README.md): Features, default controls, and how to run the project
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/delta1513/whiteboard.deltadelta.dev/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for agents that work on the code
